Midcap & Smallcap: Buy-Side Liquidity MIN, Sell-Side Liquidity HIGH

Thin bids + heavy offers = selling pressure. These NSE midcap / smallcap names showed the clearest distribution: sharp falls on high volume, weak intraday buying, sellers dominating the order book. Not financial advice — always check live market depth (5-level bid/ask, bid-ask %, delivery %) before trading.

BUY-SIDE MIN: few bids / wide spread SELL-SIDE HIGH: heavy offers / high volume fall

How to read this

Buy-side min = buyers disappeared, low bid quantity, support breaks on small selling. Sell-side high = large offer quantity stacked above price, fall on 1.3x–19x relative volume, lower circuits / breakdowns.

What to check live

Market depth bid/ask spread >0.3–0.5% = illiquid. Fall on heavy volume = real supply. Fall on light volume = just no buyers. Use limit orders, avoid market orders in thin books.
